methodologyNotes: Adversarially re-verified roster of nine real, currently- or recently-sold US food processors. Each model was re-checked against the manufacturer US product page and/or major retailer listings (Cuisinart.com, Breville.com, KitchenAid.com, HamiltonBeach.com, Best Buy, Target, Amazon, Walmart) plus editorial sources (TechRadar, Consumer Reports, Tom's Guide). Headline specs (wattage, bowl capacity) were the priority. Notable corrections this pass: KitchenAid KFP1319 motor is 1000W (draft said 500W); Breville BFP810 release year set to null (draft's 2023 was inferred from an Amazon ASIN, not a verifiable launch date); Ninja BN601 source URL replaced (the SharkNinja path served a BN600C/850W page) and motor reported as 1000 peak watts (universally published headline; ~850 rated). priceUsd reflects published US MSRP or typical current street price; dishwasher_safe = manufacturer dishwasher-safe claim for all removable parts excluding motor base; bowl_capacity_cups = primary/largest bowl. accessedAt 2026-06-15.
